about.title: Building a Solid Line of Industrial Safety
about.description: Since our founding in 1993, Green Electric has been committed to becoming a global leader in one-stop lightning protection and grounding systems, providing comprehensive safety solutions for your facilities.

story.title: Thirty Years of Craftsmanship, Achieving Systematic Safety
story.paragraph1: Green Electric was founded in 1993 in Wuxi, China, initially focusing on electrical equipment manufacturing. With an unwavering commitment to safety standards, we have established a first-class reputation in the industry.
story.paragraph2: As industrial safety needs evolved, we strategically integrated Lightning Protection Systems and Grounding Solutions. We realized that true safety comes from perfect synergy between components, not just stacking individual products.
story.paragraph3: Today, Green Electric has grown into a leading enterprise with one-stop supply capabilities. From lightning rods and electrolytic ion grounding electrodes to exothermic welding construction accessories, and even the steel and aluminum profiles that support foundation engineering, we provide complete material support covering the entire project lifecycle.

advantages.title: Advantages of One-Stop Solutions
advantages.description: We are not just a material supplier, but your systematic safety partner

compatibility.title: System Compatibility Assurance
compatibility.description: From interception terminals to grounding electrodes, all components are designed following unified technical specifications, ensuring optimal electrical continuity and corrosion resistance.

procurement.title: Simplified Procurement Process
procurement.description: A single supplier can cover all lightning protection consumables, foundation steel materials, and precision accessories, significantly reducing communication, logistics, and time costs.

engineering.title: Professional Engineering Support
engineering.description: We provide specialized static protection recommendations for hazardous locations such as flammable and explosive areas, and support material matching solutions for critical processes like exothermic welding.
